docs.title: 1. endpos 及其等价类
docs.text:
在下文中，\(\operatorname{sub}(s)\) 表示 \(s\) 的所有子串构成的集合（包括空串），\(\operatorname{suf}(s)\) 表示 \(s\) 的所有后缀构成的集合（包括空串）

对于给定的文本串 \(s\)，及其子串 \(s'\)，\(s'\) 在 \(s\) 中的所有出现位置的最后一个字符的下标所构成的集合即 \(s'\) 的 \(\operatorname{endpos}\) 等价类为 \(\operatorname{endpos}_{s}(s')\)

以 \(s=abcbc\) 为例，观察 \(s\) 的子串 \(、texttt{bc}\) 出现位置 \(\{[2,3],[4,5]\}\)，有其 \(\operatorname{endpos}\) 为 \(\{3,5\}\)。继续观察，注意到子串 \(\texttt{c}\) 的 \(\operatorname{endpos}\) 同样为 \(\{3,5\}\)，那么有对于文本串 \(\texttt{s}\)，子串 \(\texttt{c},\texttt{bc}\) 处于同一个 \(\operatorname{endpos}\) 等价类，进一步的，有 \(\{\texttt{c},\texttt{bc}\}\) 构成了一个极大 \(\operatorname{endpos}\) 等价类。

在下文中，规定 \([s']\) 表示以 \(s\) 为文本串，\(s'\) 所处的极大 \(\operatorname{endpos}\) 等价类。

对于 \(\operatorname{endpos}\) 等价类 \([s']\)，有 \(\operatorname{len}_{[s']} = \forall t \in [s'],\max(|t|)\)

docs.title: 引入
docs.text:
In the classic string mathcing problem for text, we are given a text \(w\) and a pattern string \(x\) and we want to know if \(x\) apperas in \(w\), i.e., if \(x\) is a subword if \(w\). Standard approaches to this problem invovle various methods for preprocessung \(x\) so that the text \(w\) can be searched rapidly [\(1, 9, 16\)]. Since each search still takes time proportional to the length of \(w\), this method is inappropriate when many different patterns database. In this case, it is desireable to preprocess the text itself, biulding an auxiliary data structure that allows one to determine whether \(x\) is a subword of \(w\) in time proportional to the length of \(x\), not \(w\). Data structures with this property (known as 'suffix trees' or 'compact position trees', earlier as 'Patricia trees') have been developed [\(17, 19, 21, 23, 24, 25, 26, 28\)] and used in a wide variety of pattern mathcing applications, in addtion to the classci string mathcing problem given above (e.g., [\(2, 3, 4, 5, 22, 27\)]).
